targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM sources WHERE crawl_status <> 'ok' AND active
SELECT count(*) FROM review_queue WHERE status = 'open'

panels.title: Pages fetched per hour by status

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', fetched_at) AS time, http_status::text AS metric, count(*) FROM crawl_pages WHERE fetched_at > now() - interval '2 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, sum(cost_usd_micros) / 1e6 AS usd FROM llm_extraction_log GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stale prices by source (> cache TTL)

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name, count(*) FROM price_current pc JOIN listings l ON l.id = pc.listing_id JOIN sources s ON s.id = l.source_id WHERE pc.observed_at < now() - make_interval(hours => s.cache_ttl_hours) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
